finding.summary: The new range syntax now flows through formula-rewriting code paths that cannot parse it (row/column insert, delete, move, autofill), and no test covers a sheet containing `=SUM(A:A)` when structure changes.
finding.evidence: `shiftFormula` (src/model/worksheet/shifting.ts:360-379) and `moveFormula` (ibid. 80-84) split a REFERENCE token on ':' and call `parseARef(endpoint)`; `parseARef` throws `Invalid Reference` for a column-only/row-only endpoint (src/model/core/coordinates.ts:362-369). The diff adds no test in test/sheet/shifting.test.ts, test/sheet/manipulation.test.ts, test/sheet/moving.test.ts or test/sheet/autofill.test.ts exercising insert/delete/move/fill on a sheet whose formula is `=SUM(A:A)` or `=SUM(1:1)`, so a throw/`#REF!` corruption on the newly-legal syntax would not be caught.
